title: ACT Team Selection Survey
description: Submit your ACT team selection before the deadline.

title: Submit Onboarding Feedback Survey
description: Anonymous feedback survey on the first two weeks of Onboarding; entries submitted by the deadline are eligible for an Anderson-branded MiiR tumbler raffle.

title: PIER Session 2
description: Review the Session 1 slide deck beforehand.

title: Welcome to Tech @ Anderson reception
description: Welcome reception for FTMBA/EMBA/FEMBA classes, Crown Auditorium.

title: Pick up name tag/name tent
description: Ready for pickup at the Student Business Center (D-212).

title: Schedule ITIN/W-7 Zoom appointment
description: Reply with availability for a Zoom appointment: Wed 9/2 8-10am, Thu 9/3 8-9am, or Fri 9/4 8-10am. Complete your GLACIER record and send required documents at least 24 hours before the chosen slot.

title: Pick up Anderson sweatshirt
description: If missed at distribution, pick up at Student Affairs (G307), Mon-Fri 8am-5pm.

title: Apply for AVIP Impact Investing Program
description: Optional student-led impact investing fund; eligible as a first-year FTMBA student. Application deadline 9/4 at 11:59pm.

title: Pay Fall tuition & fee assessment
description: Review your Fall fee assessment on Bruin Bill and submit payment. Missing the deadline drops your courses and places a hold on your account.

title: Sign up for a waiver exam (optional)
description: If you want to waive MGMTFT 405 Managerial Economics (Tue 9/1, 5-6:30pm, D301) or MGMTFT 416 Global Economics (Fri 9/4, 4:30-6pm, B313), register via the sign-up link. Optional.

title: Book coffee chat with Prof. Hershfield
description: Optional office-hours coffee chat sign-up via Calendly.

title: Resolve Check-in 2 access issue
description: The TA reopened Check-in 2 after you missed it, but your follow-up asking for the Zoom passcode looks unanswered — confirm whether you actually completed it.

title: Upload resume v1 to Parker2028 folder
description: Anderson-format resume, uploaded to your Parker2028 folder in the Parker Portal. You flagged this email yourself — worth double-checking it's actually done.

title: Complete Advize Assignment
description: Watch at least 3 Advizers (30+ minutes total) and answer the 4 questions on Advize. Was due the week of Aug 17.

title: Complete Stage 1 on Launchpad
description: Upload your completed brief (or the Career Destination tab of the PCS Worksheet) to your Parker2028 folder — due before your PCS session, Mon 8/10 (Sections A/B) or Wed 8/12 (Sections C/D).
